description: PHP extension installation matrix — the data half of core/cli/lib/generators/php-extensions.sh (696 lines of Bash case statements), extracted so the Bash CLI and the Rust generator can share one source of truth.

installMethods.builtin: Always compiled into the base image; MUST be skipped entirely (no install line emitted).
installMethods.core: docker-php-ext-install <ext>, after any `configure` command and apt packages.
installMethods.composer: NOT a PHP extension — a Composer package. `composer require <ext>` in the project, not in the Dockerfile.
installMethods.special: Requires a bespoke install sequence (e.g. Oracle Instant Client). NOT IMPLEMENTED in v1 — readers MUST reject with a clear error rather than silently skipping.

always.note: Present in every PHP build regardless of version.

sincePhp80.note: Enabled by default since PHP 8.0. StackVo targets 8.0+ only, so these are treated as unconditionally builtin.

uiDefault.appliesWhen: The UI pre-selects checkboxes in the new-project form
uiDefault.note: Differs from generatorFallback — see CONFLICTS.md C-05.

imap.note: Removed from PHP core in 8.2. Requesting it on PHP >= 8.2 MUST fail the build with a clear message, not be silently dropped — it is still in the .env default extension set (CONFLICTS.md C-06).

ldap.note: The configure line hardcodes the x86_64 multiarch triplet; it breaks on arm64 base images (CONFLICTS.md C-07).

mongodb.note: 2.3.3 requires PHP >= 8.1 (package.xml <min>8.1.0</min>), so 8.0 stays on the 1.19.x line. The 2.x driver is a BC break: Manager::executeBulkWrite() takes an options array, not a WriteConcern.

monolog.note: Listed in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_PHP_EXTENSIONS but it is a Composer library, not an extension.

pdo_oci.note: Requires Oracle Instant Client. requires_special_setup() flags it but no generator implements it — v1 MUST reject.

xmlrpc.note: Unreachable in v1: StackVo's minimum PHP is 8.0 and is_deprecated_extension() rejects xmlrpc on every version, yet it is still offered in the .env catalog (CONFLICTS.md C-08).

zlib.note: Listed as always-builtin AND given an apt package by the source. Treated as builtin (no install line); the package is still emitted because other extensions link against it.

resolution.description: Deterministic algorithm every generator MUST follow, given (phpVersion, requestedExtensions).
steps: 1. Normalise: lowercase, trim, de-duplicate, preserve first-seen order.
2. Reject unknown names (not a key of `extensions`) with an error naming the extension.
3. Reject install=special with 'not supported in v1'.
4. Move install=composer entries to a separate composerPackages list; they never enter the Dockerfile.
5. Reject any extension whose `removedIn` is <= phpVersion (semver-ish major.minor compare).
6. Reject any extension whose `minPhp` is > phpVersion.

7. Drop install=builtin entries ENTIRELY — no install line AND no apt packages. Verified against the Bash generator: `project.sh` hits `continue` before it reaches `get_extension_packages`, so a project requesting `dom` gets no libxml2-dev. Adding the packages anyway would be defensible but would change every generated image, so v1 matches the existing behaviour and leaves the question to v2.
8. Expand peclDependencies transitively and prepend them (redis pulls igbinary before itself).
9. aptPackages = union of `packages` over all surviving extensions, sorted, de-duplicated.
10. For pecl entries resolve the version: peclVersions[phpVersion] ?? peclVersions.default ?? 'latest'. 'latest' means emit a bare `pecl install <ext>` with no version pin.
11. aptPackages are sorted and de-duplicated (`sort -u`); every other list keeps manifest order.

12. docker-php-ext-install is emitted as up to FOUR batched RUN lines, in this order: `pdo` alone; then pdo_mysql/pdo_pgsql/pdo_sqlite/mysqli/pgsql; then dom/xml/simplexml/xmlreader/xmlwriter/xmlrpc; then everything else. The grouping is not cosmetic — xmlreader and xmlwriter need dom's headers present in the same layer, and pdo must exist before the pdo_* drivers compile.
13. Emit in order: apt install block -> configure commands -> docker-php-ext-install batches -> pecl install + docker-php-ext-enable (one RUN per extension, dependencies first).
resolution.errorPolicy: v1 changes behaviour from the Bash original: unknown/incompatible extensions are HARD ERRORS surfaced to the user, not silent no-ops. The Bash `*)` catch-all returning an empty package list is what makes typos produce a container that builds but lacks the extension.
